subject: Renewal + Capacity Add-on — billing payor split and PO onboarding
messages:
From: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@brightlayer.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightLayer Procurement <procurement@brightlayer.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + upsell — billing entity + PO details

Hi Evelyn / Ben,

We're ready to finalize the renewal and the additional capacity discussed in last week's call. Procurement asked me to confirm a couple billing items before we raise the PO: 

- Legal payor: invoice should be made out to "BrightLayer Global, LLC" (we have multiple subsidiaries).
- Split invoicing: we'd like the renewal invoice split across two cost centers (R&D / Ops) — can Redwood issue two invoices split 70/30?
- Net terms: we'd prefer Net45 for this purchase; please confirm whether that affects pricing or requires credit approval.
- Required tax form: we need Redwood's current W-9 for our finance records.

I'm attaching a draft PO for the capacity add-on (attachment: BrightLayer_PO_draft_12345.pdf). If you can confirm the invoice remit address and whether Redwood can accept the PO as-is, we'll route it through our procurement system this week.

Thanks,
Samir Kapoor
Director, Procurement — BrightLayer
procurement@brightlayer.com

[attachment: BrightLayer_PO_draft_12345.pdf]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 2 Oct 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + upsell — billing entity + PO details

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear ask and the PO draft. Quick answers below and next steps: 

- Billing entity: we can invoice to "BrightLayer Global, LLC". Please put that exact name on the PO to avoid hold-ups.
- Split invoices: Finance can issue two invoices split 70/30. We will generate two separate invoice numbers and can place both on the same DocuSign/AR package if that helps your AP system.
- Net terms: Net45 is fine for this renewal; because it's a commitment increase we need a short internal credit check. That won't affect unit pricing for this quarter.
- W-9: attached is our current W-9 (W9_REDWOOD_2027.pdf).

Action items for procurement:
1) Submit the PO with the legal name and include the two cost center codes in the PO line items (we need line-level cost centers to split correctly).
2) Send PO to billing@redwood.com and cc marissa_cole@redwood.com.
3) If you prefer DocuSign, let us know and we'll send an invoice envelope that maps the two amounts.

I'll loop in Marissa from Billing to prepare the two-invoice flow and a DocuSign link so you can sign quickly.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com
+1 (555) 312-8874

Subject: Invoice prep and DocuSign envelope for PO processing

Hi Samir — Marissa from Billing here. Per Evelyn's note, I've prepared a draft invoice preview and a DocuSign envelope so BrightLayer can sign and attach the PO.

What I'll do once we receive the PO: 
- Create two invoices split 70/30 tied to the PO number you provide.
- Apply Net45 payment terms on both invoices.
- Send a DocuSign invoice package that contains both invoice PDFs and a single signature field (signing covers both).

Please confirm the following so I can finalize: 
- PO number you will submit (we need exact string to tie to AR).
- Cost center codes for the two lines.
- Remit address (if different from the legal name) — we will print the remit line per your AP preferences.

DocuSign link (draft envelope): https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123def456

If you prefer the PO emailed directly to billing@redwood.com, that's fine — I monitor that inbox.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Billing Operations — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Marissa / Evelyn — thanks for the fast turnaround. A few confirmations from our side: 

- We'll issue PO BL-PO-98765 and email it to billing@redwood.com by end of day tomorrow.
- Cost centers: 4001 (R&D) and 7003 (Ops) — please split 70/30 accordingly.
- Remit name/address should be "BrightLayer Global, LLC" / 110 Market Way, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105.
- DocuSign is fine — please include both invoices in the envelope and mark the envelope subject with the PO number.

One request: can you also send the updated SOW that reflects the capacity add-on (we need it attached for internal approvals)? I saw Redwood_SOW_v2.docx in the attachment — please confirm that's the latest and include it in the DocuSign package.

I'll route BL-PO-98765 to billing@redwood.com and cc you both. Appreciate the help getting this over the finish line.

Best,
